sections.campus: Big campus with a lot happening: clubs, sports and fests all year. Hostel food is average but the facilities around make up for it.
sections.internships: Internship support exists, but you need to apply early and keep your profile active to get good offers.
sections.placement: Placement drives are frequent and many companies visit. Packages vary a lot by branch, so check your own department first.

sections.campus: Good city location and a professional atmosphere. Classes are regular and faculty are approachable for doubts.
sections.internships: Live projects and short internships are part of the course which helped me understand real work.
sections.placement: Placement cell trains you for interviews. Strong effort from the student side is needed for the best offers.

sections.campus: Intense and rewarding. The peer group is exceptional and the learning mostly happens outside the classroom too.
sections.internships: Summer internship is a major part of the experience and the recruiters are top names.
sections.placement: Final placements are well organised and fair. Preparation from the first term really helps.

sections.campus: Friendly campus with students from many countries. Library and labs are well maintained.
sections.internships: Some internship opportunities through the college, but I found most through my own network.
sections.placement: Placements are decent for core branches. I would suggest building skills alongside the curriculum.

sections.campus: Compact campus but a very active student community. Case competitions and societies are a big plus.
sections.internships: Strong industry exposure and internship opportunities for those who are consistent.
sections.placement: One of the best value-for-money MBA options. Placements are strong and recruiters are consistent.

sections.campus: Lively campus life with events nearly every week. Infrastructure is modern and well kept.
sections.internships: Good number of internship drives, especially in IT and core companies.
sections.placement: Many companies visit for placements. Academic rigour can differ between departments.

sections.campus: Moot court and legal aid activities are encouraged. Faculty is supportive when you show interest.
sections.internships: Internships with courts and law firms are expected every semester, which builds good exposure.
sections.placement: Placement options are growing for law students. Self-driven networking helps a lot.

sections.campus: Hospital exposure starts early and the teaching hospital is busy, so there is plenty to learn from.
sections.internships: Clinical postings are structured and you get real patient interaction under supervision.
sections.placement: Most students prepare for PG entrance exams. The institute supports with guidance and mock tests.
